name: Dubrovnik Airport Ruđer Bošković

slots.v: schedules facilitated (IATA Level 2) in the summer season, including general and business aviation; messages in IATA SSIM chapter 6 format (SMA/SCR) to the airport's schedule coordinator
slots.quote: is a regulated airport (Level 2) during the summer flight schedule

permits.v: before take-off to Dubrovnik the captain must e-mail a general declaration with all passenger identity data to the airport's border control
